About the Shasta Wheelmen Weekday Ride group ride

Redding's road club rides Tuesday and Thursday mornings from the Sundial Bridge lot. A rotating set of 24 numbered routes, 28 to 42 miles, through Old Shasta, Palo Cedro, Anderson and the Shasta Dam loop. Start time moves with the season. Non-members bring a signed waiver. Weekend rides start from other spots and are on the club's Google calendar.
